# crusoe_kubernetes_available_addons (Data Source)

Available only to organizations enrolled by Crusoe support; the API rejects it otherwise. Reach out to support@crusoecloud.com to enable it.

Fetches the add-ons available for a Kubernetes version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crusoe_kubernetes_available_addons" "example" {
  cluster_id = "my-cluster-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cluster_id` (String) ID of the cluster whose Kubernetes version is used to list available add-ons. Exactly one of cluster_id or kubernetes_version must be set.
- `kubernetes_version` (String) Kubernetes version (major.minor) to list available add-ons for. Exactly one of cluster_id or kubernetes_version must be set.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the add-on belongs to. If not specified, the project ID will be inferred from the Crusoe configuration.

### Read-Only

- `addons` (Attributes List) List of add-ons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addons))

<a id="nestedatt--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addons`

Read-Only:

- `addon_type` (String) Type of the add-on, e.g. `cert-manager`.
- `category` (String) Category of the add-on. Possible values: `preinstalled`, `optional`.
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the add-on.
- `removable` (Boolean) Whether the customer may remove the add-on once installed.
- `versions` (List of String) Installable versions for the requested Kubernetes version.
